items.headline: T20 World Cup begins in Australia; Kohli stars
items.detail: The ICC Men's T20 World Cup ran in Australia from October 16 to November 13, 2022. Virat Kohli played an unbeaten 82 against Pakistan at the Melbourne Cricket Ground and finished the tournament as its highest run-scorer with 296 runs.

items.headline: 5G telecom services launched in 13 cities
items.detail: India's 5G telecom services went live on October 1, 2022, starting in 13 selected cities ahead of a nationwide rollout.

items.headline: Nobel Medicine to Svante Paabo for ancient genomes
items.detail: The 2022 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine went to Sweden's Svante Paabo for his discoveries on the genomes of extinct hominins and human evolution.

items.headline: Nobel Physics for entangled-photon experiments
items.detail: Alain Aspect (France), John Clauser (US) and Anton Zeilinger (Austria) shared the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics for experiments with entangled photons that established the violation of Bell inequalities and pioneered quantum information science.

items.headline: Nobel Chemistry for click chemistry
items.detail: Carolyn Bertozzi (US), Morten Meldal (Denmark) and Barry Sharpless (US) won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry for developing click chemistry and bioorthogonal chemistry. It was Sharpless's second Nobel.

items.headline: Annie Ernaux wins the Nobel Literature
items.detail: French writer Annie Ernaux won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Literature, cited for the courage and clinical acuity with which she explores personal memory and collective restraints.

items.headline: Nobel Peace for human-rights champions
items.detail: The 2022 Nobel Peace Prize went to Ales Bialiatski of Belarus, the Russian organisation Memorial and Ukraine's Centre for Civil Liberties for their civil-society efforts defending citizen rights and documenting abuses of power.
examFacts: Laureates: Bialiatski, Memorial, Centre for Civil Liberties

items.headline: Nobel Economics for bank-and-crisis research
items.detail: Ben Bernanke, Douglas Diamond and Philip Dybvig (all US) won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Economic Sciences for research on banks and financial crises.

items.headline: CJI Lalit names Justice Chandrachud his successor
items.detail: Chief Justice U. U. Lalit recommended Justice D. Y. Chandrachud as his successor before retiring on November 8, 2022 - setting up the 50th CJI.

items.headline: Mallikarjun Kharge elected Congress president
items.detail: Mallikarjun Kharge defeated Shashi Tharoor to become Congress president on October 19, 2022 - the party's first non-Gandhi president in 24 years.

items.headline: ISRO's LVM3 flies its first commercial mission
items.detail: On October 22, 2022 ISRO's LVM3 rocket flew its first commercial mission, LVM3-M2, injecting 36 OneWeb satellites into low Earth orbit from Sriharikota.

items.headline: Rishi Sunak becomes UK Prime Minister
items.detail: Rishi Sunak took office as Britain's Prime Minister on October 25, 2022, appointed by King Charles III - the first British Asian to hold the office and, at 42, the youngest PM since 1812. He succeeded Liz Truss, who had announced her resignation on October 20.

items.headline: BCCI announces equal match fees for men and women
items.detail: On October 27, 2022 the BCCI announced equal match fees for India's men and women cricketers across all three formats.

items.headline: Morbi suspension bridge collapses in Gujarat
items.detail: The colonial-era 'Jhulto Pul' suspension bridge over the Machchhu river at Morbi, Gujarat collapsed on the evening of October 30, 2022, killing at least 141 people. It had reopened just five days earlier after renovation.

items.headline: National Unity Day observed on October 31
items.detail: Rashtriya Ekta Diwas (National Unity Day) was observed on October 31, marking Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel's birth anniversary. Observed since 2014, it honours Patel's role in India's political integration.

quiz.q: India's 5G telecom services were launched on October 1, 2022 in how many cities?
quiz.solution: 5G services went live on October 1, 2022, starting in 13 selected cities.

quiz.q: Who won the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine?
quiz.solution: Svante Paabo won for his discoveries on the genomes of extinct hominins and human evolution.

quiz.q: The 2022 Nobel Prize in Chemistry was awarded for developing:
quiz.solution: Bertozzi, Meldal and Sharpless won for click chemistry and bioorthogonal chemistry.

quiz.q: At 42, the youngest British Prime Minister since 1812, appointed in October 2022, is:
quiz.solution: Rishi Sunak took office on October 25, 2022 - the first British Asian PM and the youngest since 1812.

quiz.q: ISRO's first commercial LVM3 mission, LVM3-M2 of October 2022, carried how many satellites?
quiz.solution: LVM3-M2 launched 36 OneWeb satellites into low Earth orbit on October 22, 2022.

quiz.q: The Morbi bridge that collapsed on October 30, 2022 spanned which river?
quiz.solution: The 'Jhulto Pul' stood over the Machchhu river at Morbi, Gujarat; at least 141 people died.

quiz.q: Who became Congress president in October 2022 - the first non-Gandhi in 24 years?
quiz.solution: Kharge defeated Shashi Tharoor in the October 19, 2022 election.

quiz.q: In October 2022 the BCCI announced equal match fees for:
quiz.solution: The announcement of October 27, 2022 made match fees equal for men and women across all formats.

quiz.q: National Unity Day (Rashtriya Ekta Diwas), observed since 2014, falls on:
quiz.solution: It is observed on October 31, the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel.

quiz.q: The 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup was hosted by:
quiz.solution: The tournament ran October 16 - November 13, 2022 across Australian cities; Kohli was its highest run-scorer (296).

items.headline: COP27 agrees loss and damage fund
items.detail: The UN climate conference COP27 ran November 6-20, 2022 at Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt with about 35,000 delegates. In a first, countries agreed to set up a loss and damage fund to help nations worst hit by climate disasters.
examFacts: First-ever loss and damage fund agreed

items.headline: Justice Chandrachud sworn in as 50th CJI
items.detail: Justice Dhananjaya Y. Chandrachud was sworn in as the 50th Chief Justice of India on November 9, 2022, a day after Justice U. U. Lalit retired. His term ran until November 10, 2024.

items.headline: Russia pulls out of Kherson city
items.detail: Russian forces completed their withdrawal from Kherson city in early November 2022, and Ukrainian troops entered on November 11. Kherson was the only regional capital Russia had captured in the 2022 invasion.
examFacts: Only regional capital Russia had taken

items.headline: Crypto exchange FTX files for bankruptcy
items.detail: FTX, one of the world's largest crypto exchanges, filed for bankruptcy in the US on November 11, 2022 after a run on deposits. Founder Sam Bankman-Fried was arrested in the Bahamas on December 12, 2022.

items.headline: England win T20 World Cup at the MCG
items.detail: England beat Pakistan by five wickets in the T20 World Cup final at the Melbourne Cricket Ground on November 13, 2022 for their second T20 title. Sam Curran was named both Player of the Match and Player of the Tournament.

items.headline: World population reaches 8 billion
items.detail: The United Nations marked November 15, 2022 as the approximate day the world population crossed 8 billion, crediting better health and falling mortality. UN projections see growth peaking at around 10.4 billion in the 2080s.
examFacts: Projected peak: about 10.4 billion in the 2080s

items.headline: G20 summit held in Bali
items.detail: The 17th G20 summit met at Nusa Dua, Bali on November 15-16, 2022 under Indonesia's chairmanship with the motto 'Recover Together, Recover Stronger'. The closing declaration noted most members condemned Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and India's presidency began on December 1, 2022.
examFacts: India took over the presidency from December 1, 2022

items.headline: NASA launches Artemis 1 to the Moon
items.detail: NASA launched Artemis 1 on November 16, 2022 from Kennedy Space Center - the first flight of the Space Launch System rocket carrying the Orion capsule on an uncrewed test flight around the Moon, ahead of future crewed missions.
examFacts: Rocket: Space Launch System; craft: Orion

items.headline: Skyroot launches India's first private rocket
items.detail: Hyderabad-based startup Skyroot Aerospace launched Vikram-S, India's first privately built rocket, from Sriharikota on November 18, 2022 under the mission 'Prarambh'. The single-stage solid-fuel rocket reached about 89.5 km altitude.
examFacts: Vikram-S: first Indian privately built rocket

items.headline: Kashi Tamil Sangamam opens at Varanasi
items.detail: PM Modi inaugurated the month-long Kashi Tamil Sangamam at Varanasi on November 19, 2022, an education ministry cultural exchange celebrating centuries-old links between Tamil Nadu and Kashi under Ek Bharat Shrestha Bharat.

items.headline: General Asim Munir named Pakistan Army chief
items.detail: Pakistan appointed General Asim Munir as Chief of Army Staff on November 24, 2022; he took charge on November 29, succeeding Qamar Javed Bajwa.

items.headline: Constitution Day observed on November 26
items.detail: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) was observed on November 26, marking the Constituent Assembly's adoption of the Constitution in 1949. It has been observed annually since 2015.

quiz.q: Who became the 50th Chief Justice of India in November 2022?
quiz.solution: Justice D. Y. Chandrachud was sworn in on November 9, 2022 after U. U. Lalit retired.

quiz.q: Which team won the 2022 ICC Men's T20 World Cup?
quiz.solution: England beat Pakistan by five wickets at the MCG on November 13, 2022.

quiz.q: Who was named Player of the Match in the 2022 T20 World Cup final?
quiz.solution: England's Sam Curran was both Player of the Match and Player of the Tournament.

quiz.q: The UN marked which date as the day world population crossed 8 billion?
quiz.solution: The Day of Eight Billion was November 15, 2022.

quiz.q: Vikram-S, India's first privately built rocket, was made by which startup?
quiz.solution: Skyroot launched Vikram-S from Sriharikota on November 18, 2022 under mission Prarambh.

quiz.q: COP27 in November 2022 was hosted by which city?
quiz.solution: COP27 ran November 6-20, 2022 at Sharm El-Sheikh, Egypt.

quiz.q: The landmark climate-finance outcome of COP27 was a fund for:
quiz.solution: COP27 agreed, for the first time, to a loss and damage fund for vulnerable countries.

quiz.q: The 2022 G20 summit was held at:
quiz.solution: The 17th G20 summit met at Nusa Dua, Bali on November 15-16, 2022.

quiz.q: Who was appointed Pakistan's Army Chief in November 2022?
quiz.solution: General Asim Munir was named COAS on November 24, 2022 and took charge five days later.

quiz.q: Constitution Day of India, observed since 2015, falls on:
quiz.solution: It marks the Constituent Assembly's adoption of the Constitution on November 26, 1949.

items.headline: India takes charge of G20 presidency
items.detail: India assumed the G20 presidency on December 1, 2022, holding it until November 30, 2023, after taking over from Indonesia at the Bali summit. The theme was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future', and the 18th G20 Leaders' Summit was set for New Delhi in September 2023.
examFacts: Theme: One Earth, One Family, One Future

items.headline: AAP sweeps Delhi MCD elections
items.detail: Voting for the unified 250-member Municipal Corporation of Delhi was held on December 4, 2022, with results on December 7. The Aam Aadmi Party won 134 seats to end the BJP's long control of Delhi's civic body; the BJP got 104 and Congress 9.

items.headline: G7 caps Russian seaborne oil at $60
items.detail: The G7, EU and Australia put a US$60-per-barrel price cap on Russian seaborne crude from December 5, 2022. Western shippers and insurers could serve Russian oil cargoes only if they were priced at or below the cap.

items.headline: Mirabai Chanu takes Worlds silver in Bogota
items.detail: At the 2022 World Weightlifting Championships in Bogota, Colombia (December 5-16), India's Mirabai Chanu won silver in the women's 49 kg with a 200 kg total. China topped the medal table.

items.headline: RBI raises repo rate to 6.25 percent
items.detail: The RBI's Monetary Policy Committee on December 7, 2022 raised the repo rate by 35 basis points to 6.25 percent - the fifth straight increase, taking cumulative tightening to 225 basis points since May 2022. It was the smallest hike of that cycle.

items.headline: China scraps zero-COVID policy
items.detail: On December 7, 2022, China announced a sweeping loosening of its strict zero-COVID rules - dropping compulsory PCR tests and quarantine - after nationwide protests and heavy economic costs. It was the last major economy to abandon the approach.

items.headline: Peru President Castillo ousted after self-coup bid
items.detail: On December 7, 2022, Peru's President Pedro Castillo announced the dissolution of Congress in a self-coup attempt; Congress impeached and removed him the same day by 101 votes to 6. Vice President Dina Boluarte was sworn in as president and Castillo was arrested.

items.headline: BJP wins record 156 seats in Gujarat
items.detail: Results on December 8, 2022 gave the BJP 156 of Gujarat's 182 seats with 52.5% votes - the best tally any party has ever won in the state. Congress collapsed to 17 seats, while the Aam Aadmi Party opened its account with 5. Bhupendra Patel continued as Chief Minister.

items.headline: Congress ousts BJP in Himachal Pradesh
items.detail: The December 8, 2022 results for Himachal Pradesh's 68-seat assembly gave the Congress 40 seats against the BJP's 25, continuing the hill state's trend of voting out incumbent governments since 1985. Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu became Chief Minister, with Mukesh Agnihotri as Deputy CM.

items.headline: NASA's Artemis 1 returns Orion safely
items.detail: NASA's Artemis 1 uncrewed Moon mission ended on December 11, 2022 when the Orion capsule splashed down in the Pacific after a 25-day flight. It was the first integrated flight of the Space Launch System rocket and Orion, and Orion set a record for the farthest distance travelled by a human-rated spacecraft (over 432,000 km).

items.headline: Argentina beat France for FIFA World Cup
items.detail: Argentina won their third FIFA World Cup on December 18, 2022, beating holders France 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 extra-time thriller at Lusail Stadium, Qatar. Lionel Messi won the Golden Ball as player of the tournament; Kylian Mbappe took the Golden Boot with 8 goals including a final hat-trick.
examFacts: Golden Ball: Messi; Golden Boot: Mbappe (8)

items.headline: Zelenskyy addresses US Congress
items.detail: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy addressed a joint session of the US Congress on December 21, 2022 - his first trip outside Ukraine since Russia's full-scale invasion began - pressing for continued American military and financial aid.

items.headline: National Mathematics Day observed
items.detail: National Mathematics Day was observed on December 22, marking the birth anniversary of mathematician Srinivasa Ramanujan. The day was declared in 2011 to honour Ramanujan on his 125th birth anniversary.

items.headline: Sam Curran becomes IPL's costliest buy
items.detail: At the IPL 2023 mini-auction in Kochi on December 23, 2022, England all-rounder Sam Curran became the most expensive player in IPL history when Punjab Kings bought him for Rs 18.5 crore.
examFacts: Sam Curran: Rs 18.5 crore, Punjab Kings

items.headline: Netanyahu sworn in to lead Israel again
items.detail: Benjamin Netanyahu was sworn in as Israel's Prime Minister on December 29, 2022, heading the country's 37th government after his Likud-led bloc won the November 2022 Knesset election.

items.headline: Football legend Pele dies at 82
items.detail: Brazilian great Pele, the only player to win three FIFA World Cups (1958, 1962, 1970), died in Sao Paulo on December 29, 2022 at the age of 82.

items.headline: Pope Emeritus Benedict XVI dies at 95
items.detail: Pope Benedict XVI, born Joseph Ratzinger, died on December 31, 2022 at 95. He led the Catholic Church from 2005 to 2013 and became the first pope in nearly 600 years to resign when he stepped down citing health reasons.

quiz.q: Which country won the 2022 FIFA World Cup in Qatar?
quiz.solution: Argentina beat France 4-2 on penalties after a 3-3 final at Lusail on December 18, 2022.

quiz.q: Who won the Golden Ball as best player of the 2022 FIFA World Cup?
quiz.solution: Messi won his second Golden Ball; Mbappe took the Golden Boot with 8 goals.

quiz.q: What was India's G20 presidency theme for 2022-23?
quiz.solution: The theme was 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam - One Earth, One Family, One Future'.

quiz.q: By how much did the RBI raise the repo rate at its December 2022 policy review?
quiz.solution: The December 7, 2022 hike of 35 bps took the repo rate to 6.25%.

quiz.q: What repo rate level did the RBI set at its December 2022 policy?
quiz.solution: After the fifth straight hike, the repo rate stood at 6.25% in December 2022.

quiz.q: How many seats did the BJP win in the December 2022 Gujarat assembly election?
quiz.solution: BJP's 156 of 182 seats was the best tally any party has won in Gujarat.

quiz.q: Who became Chief Minister of Himachal Pradesh after the December 2022 results?
quiz.solution: Congress won 40 of 68 seats and chose Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu as CM.

quiz.q: Which party won majority in the December 2022 Delhi MCD election?
quiz.solution: AAP won 134 of 250 wards, ending BJP's run atop Delhi's civic body.

quiz.q: Pele, who died in December 2022, won how many FIFA World Cups?
quiz.solution: He is the only player with three World Cup wins: 1958, 1962 and 1970.

quiz.q: Benedict XVI's 2013 resignation was the first papal resignation since which year?
quiz.solution: He was the first pope to resign since Gregory XII in 1415.
